```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
tourism_region <- tourism %>%
  select(Region) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(region = Region) |> 
  arrange(region) %>%
  mutate(region_id = row_number())

format(object.size(tourism_region), units = "KB")

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
tourism_quarterly <- tourism %>%
  left_join(tourism_region, by = c("Region" = "region")) %>%
  transmute(
    quarter = Quarter,
    purpose = Purpose,
    trips   = round(Trips, digits = 4),
    region_id
  ) %>%
  arrange(quarter, region_id, purpose)

format(object.size(tourism_quarterly), units = "KB")

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
tourism_quarterly <- tourism_quarterly |> 
  filter(trips > 0) 

format(object.size(tourism_quarterly), units = "KB")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
usethis::use_data(tourism_quarterly, overwrite = T)
usethis::use_data(tourism_region, overwrite = T)
```

How to find region coordinates:

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# install.packages(c("sf","dplyr","stringr","fuzzyjoin","absmapsdata"))
library(sf); library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(fuzzyjoin); library(absmapsdata)
# pak::pkg_install("wfmackey/absmapsdata")

# 1) Load an authoritative layer (pick the one that matches your region type)
sa2 <- absmapsdata::sa22021 %>% 
  select(sa2_code_2021, sa2_name_2021, state_name_2021, geometry)

# 2) Normalise names on both sides (handles dashes, case, spaces)
norm <- \(x) x |>
  str_replace_all("[–—-]", "-") |>
  str_squish() |>
  str_to_title()

tourism_region2 <- tourism_region %>% mutate(region_id = region_id,
                                             region_norm = norm(region))
sa2_names <- sa2 %>% mutate(sa2_name_norm = norm(sa2_name_2021))

# 3) Fuzzy name match (adjust max_dist as needed)
matches <- stringdist_inner_join(
  tourism_region2, sa2_names,
  by = c("region_norm" = "sa2_name_norm"),
  max_dist = 2 # try 1–3 depending on how messy names are
) 

# 4) For ambiguous matches, pick the closest string distance
# matches <- matches %>%
#   group_by(region_id) %>% slice_min(.distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

# 5) Compute a point within each polygon (always inside)
sa2_pts <- sa2 %>%
  mutate(cent = st_point_on_surface(geometry),
         lon = st_coordinates(cent)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(cent)[,2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(sa2_code_2021, lon, lat)

# 6) Attach clean lon/lat to your region table
tourism_region <- matches %>%
  select(region_id, region, sa2_code_2021) %>%
  left_join(sa2_pts, by = "sa2_code_2021") %>%
  right_join(tourism_region2 %>% 
  select(region_id, region, region_id), by = "region_id") %>%
  arrange(region_id) %>%
  select(region.x, lon, lat, region_id) |> 
  rename(region = region.x)

# 7) Any still-NA? Review them:
#still_na <- tourism_region_fixed %>% filter(is.na(lon) | is.na(lat))

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
usethis::use_data(tourism_quarterly, overwrite = T)
usethis::use_data(tourism_region, overwrite = T)

```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)

# 1) Keep valid coords
spots <- tourism_region %>% filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# 2) Convert to sf (WGS84)
spots_sf <- st_as_sf(spots, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# 3) Australia basemap
aus <- ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")

# 4) Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = spots_sf, color = "#2C7FB8", alpha = 0.8, size = 1.6) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(110, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Tourism Spots in Australia", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"))
```

-   Now we add weather stations id "ws_id"

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=T}
library(dplyr)
library(geosphere)

# 1) Keep valid coords
spots  <- tourism_region %>% filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))
wstns  <- weather_stations %>% filter(!is.na(stn_lon), !is.na(stn_lat))


nearest_station_ids <- sapply(1:nrow(spots), function(i) {
    dists <- geosphere::distHaversine(
      cbind(weather_stations$stn_lon, weather_stations$stn_lat),
      c(spots$lon[i], spots$lat[i])
    )
    weather_stations$ws_id[which.min(dists)]
  })

  # Add nearest station info
  spots$ws_id <- nearest_station_ids

tourism_region <- spots
usethis::use_data(tourism_region, overwrite = T)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rnaturalearth)

# 1) Keep valid coords
spots <- tourism_region %>% filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))
wstns <- weather_stations %>% filter(!is.na(stn_lon), !is.na(stn_lat))

df <- left_join(spots, wstns, by = "ws_id")
# 2) Australia basemap
aus <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "australia", returnclass = "sf")

# 3) Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Tourism spots
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = lon, y = lat), 
             color = "#2C7FB8", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  # Weather stations
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = stn_lon, y = stn_lat), 
             color = "#D95F02", shape = 17, size = 1) +

  coord_sf(xlim = c(110, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Tourism Spots and Weather Stations in Australia",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"))

```
